verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Unit issues cards with "configurable controls" and real-time authorization (unit-docs-3), and that the Dashboard and APIs expose compliance and operational data (unit-docs-5). That is a thin, card-scoped hint at transaction controls, not a documented account- or program-level risk-control system. Missing for 10: per-account and per-program transaction and velocity limits, holds on suspicious activity, account freeze capability, documented reinstatement paths, and any detailed docs or independent corroboration of these controls.
